shelfmark: CEHM-Carso, Fondo DCXXI (Archivo de Félix Díaz): DCXXI.3.231.1 (Duhart, NY 29 Aug 1921, 21 code names), DCXXI.3.242.1 (Amaya, Havana 27 Sep 1921), DCXXI.3.263.1 and 3.278.1 (Mina, 8 and 30 Nov 1921), DCXXI.3.256.2 (2 Nov 1921, signer in code), DCXXI.3.288.1 (Suárez, 17 Dec 1921), DCXXI.3.301.2, DCXXI.3.323.1 (12 Jan 1922), DCXXI.5.474.2 (Lozano, 10 May 1922), DCXXI.5.514.1 (Moneglia, 10 Jun 1922), DCXXI.6.576.1 (25 Aug 1922), DCXXI.7.656.1 (Escudero, 6 Nov 1921)
